about: Frozen builds for npm run check:recall (qa/recall/README.md). Each is a tarball on the checks-fixtures release; recall.mjs downloads one when qa/recall/fixtures/<id> is missing and checks its sha256.

0fe749b.why: The build Chris looked at on 2026-11-08 when he listed the faults in #42 (the union-building preview until 74d93c6 landed at 18:11).

430ea4a.why: The newest evaluator build on 2026-11-10; faults are planted in it.

e2bae25.why: The stations build Chris reviewed on 2026-11-11 (the same tree as the merge 7bf19cc that put it on the live site), when he found seven faults no check had a rule for (#103).

3e38acb.why: The live build later that evening, with five of those seven fixed; the two bus-under-rail finds are still on it.
